name: usafiri-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya transport — matatu routes, NTSA services, boda-boda licensing, freight logistics, and passenger rights

tools.name: matatu_route_finder
tools.description: Estimate a matatu or bus fare between two Kenyan towns and list ways to book. Use when someone asks roughly what a trip costs. Fares come from a table of five Nairobi routes (Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, Thika); any other pair gets a flat KES 500 placeholder and fare_is_placeholder is true. Returns the origin, destination, estimated_fare_kes, fare_is_placeholder, booking options and a note to confirm fares at the terminal. Fares and routes are labelled DEMO and change often. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: ntsa_services_guide
tools.description: Explain NTSA services: driving licence, annual vehicle inspection, PSV licence and logbook ownership transfer, with the process, documents, indicative fees and duration. Use when someone asks how to complete an NTSA service. service is matched by name (spaces become underscores); an unrecognised service returns an error listing the valid ones. Returns the source label, the service, its process, documents or cost and duration, and NTSA contact details. Fees are labelled DEMO and unverified: confirm at tims.ntsa.go.ke. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: boda_licensing_guide
tools.description: List what a boda boda (motorcycle taxi) operator needs in Kenya: licence class, PSV licence, insurance, county permit, reflective jacket with SACCO number, helmets and SACCO membership. Use when someone asks how to legally operate or whether a rider is compliant. Takes an optional county that is only echoed back: the requirements are the same for every county. Returns the source label, the county, the requirements, the NTSA fee, insurance notes and SACCO benefits. Indicative figures labelled DEMO: confirm with NTSA and the county. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: freight_logistics_guide
tools.description: Compare ways to move goods in Kenya: full-load truck, bus parcel, motorbike courier and SGR cargo, with indicative price ranges and example providers. Use when someone asks how to ship cargo and roughly what it costs. origin, destination and cargo_type are only echoed back; the same options are returned for every route. Returns the source label, the echoed inputs and the options with price range and providers. Indicative prices labelled DEMO: get quotes from providers. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: transport_rights_query
tools.description: Explain passenger and shipper rights in Kenyan transport: overcharging, vehicle safety, accidents, goods loss or damage and disability access. Use when someone asks what a passenger or customer can demand or where to report. Keywords in topic select entries; if none match, ALL rights are returned. Returns the source label, the topic, the rights, NTSA's number and a not-legal-advice disclaimer. Static summary labelled DEMO: verify with NTSA. Read-only; no side effects.
